method: The listed basmati rice quantity is the dry, uncooked weight. Follow the cooking and assembly steps below for this measured portion.

Start the 75g basmati rice first: this is the uncooked weight. Use the water quantity and cooking time on the rice packet; simmer until tender, then drain if the packet method requires it. Keep covered briefly while finishing the pan, then serve immediately.
Peel and finely slice the 90g onion and deseed and thinly slice the 90g mixed peppers. Drain and pat dry the 180g firm tofu, then cut into 2cm cubes.

Heat half the listed olive oil in a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Add the firm tofu and cook for 8–10 minutes, turning carefully until lightly golden on several sides and hot through. Transfer to a clean plate; keep the pan for the vegetables. Never reuse the plate or utensils that held the raw food without washing them.

Add the remaining half of the listed olive oil to the same pan. Add 90g onion and 90g mixed peppers and cook for 6–8 minutes, stirring often, until softened with some bite. Keep the heat moderate so the small measured amount of oil does not smoke.

Turn the heat to low and fold in the 40g pepper and tomato masala. Stir for 1–2 minutes until hot, following any longer heating instruction on the sauce label. This measured sauce coats the food; do not boil it dry or add an unlisted jar of sauce.

Return the cooked firm tofu and any collected juices to the pan; fold gently to keep the cubes intact. Heat gently until the whole pan is steaming hot, stirring to distribute the heat. Spoon the pan mixture over the freshly cooked rice. Serve immediately.

review.notes: Golden intact firm tofu cubes with cooked onion strips and red/yellow peppers in pepper-tomato masala over white basmati rice. Correct separately cooked rice underneath. No meat, cheese, beans or garnish. Single central bowl with margin.
